title: MaseMan PVP
description: MaseMan PVP is a simple PVP texture pack that adds things like Low Fire, Low Shield, Custom Swords Spears and Axe textures. It also adds smiley faces to Enderpearls, Golden apples, and Windcharges.
body:
MaseMan PVP is a Simple PVP pack that adds cool new textures and little features that will make your PVP way Cleaner
Features:
-Low Fire
-Low Shield
-Custom Swords, Axes and Spear textures
-Smiley Faces on Golden apples, Wind Charges and Ender pearls
-Small Totems and other utilitys
Vanilla Tweaks was used to add some small features to this Pack https://vanillatweaks.net/
Also go Subscribe to my Youtube channel :) https://www.youtube.com/@MaseManMC

⚙️ How to Install
1. Download the .zip file from the versions tab.
2. Launch Minecraft and navigate to Options > Resource Packs.
3. Click Open Pack Folder and drop the downloaded .zip file inside.
4. Activate the pack in-game, move it to the top of your active list, and enjoy cleaner PvP!
